description: This file contains unit tests for filesystem-related classes and functions, including testing file creation, reading, writing, moving, and directory operations using Google Test framework.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for creation, reading, writing, and manipulation.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory with methods for navigation and validation.

methods.name: File::Create
methods.description: Creates a new file, optionally with specific permissions.

methods.name: File::Open
methods.description: Opens the file for reading or writing.

methods.name: File::Append
methods.description: Appends data to the file.

methods.name: File::SetSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Writes data to the file.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Reads data from the file.

methods.name: File::FileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a path.

methods.name: File::FileNameExtended
methods.description: Extracts the filename with extension from a path.

methods.name: File::PathName
methods.description: Extracts the directory path from a file path.

methods.name: File::Extension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a path.

methods.name: File::Destroy
methods.description: Deletes the file.

methods.name: File::Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: File::Move
methods.description: Moves or renames the file.

methods.name: Directory::CreatePath
methods.description: Creates the directory path.

methods.name: Directory::Create
methods.description: Creates the directory.

methods.name: Directory::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the directory is valid.

methods.name: Directory::Next
methods.description: Iterates to the next directory entry.

methods.name: Directory::Current
methods.description: Returns the current directory entry.

methods.name: Directory::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the directory.

methods.name: Directory::Reset
methods.description: Resets directory iteration.

methods.name: Directory::IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the entry is a directory.
